The '''Calrissians' place''' was the Calrissian family's retreat on [[Lujo]]. [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and his wife [[Tendra Risant Calrissian|Tendra]], along with their [[Lando Calrissian, Junior|son]], usually vacationed here as of [[43 ABY]].
